attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board of Examiners in Psychology

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 9 h from APA-approved sponsors; other sponsor-approved CE (regional/state psychological associations, credentialing bodies, APA-approved internship sites, accredited universities); peer consultation (10-20 h), non-accredited workshops (max 10 h/yr), Board/association service, supervision (max 5 h), teaching, publications, graduate courses (max 15 h), ABPP exam (20 h), volunteer care (max 4 h/yr)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure term under 2 years: 30 hours for first renewal (20 live-interactive, 9 APA-approved). Passing the TN Ethics & Jurisprudence Exam in the initial term = 3 h.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE documentation 5 years; produce on Board's written request.
rules.notes: CE earned in the 2 calendar years (Jan 1-Dec 31) before the renewal year. At least 20 h with real-time interaction. 3 h combined on TCA Title 63 Ch. 11, Board rules and professional ethics; 3 h cultural diversity.
CE earned in the 2 calendar years before the renewal year (Rule 1180-04-.01(4)(f)); 3 h cultural diversity and 3 h TN law/rules/ethics requirements in 1180-01-.08(1)(d),(f) apply.
